mapper.select: SELECT id, title, artist, release_year, genre, cover_url, bandcamp_id, created_at FROM album ORDER BY id
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.artist, a.release_year, a.genre, a.cover_url, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1), 0) AS average_rating, COUNT(r.id) AS review_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.rating >= 4) / COUNT(r.id))::int END AS positive_rate FROM album a LEFT JOIN review r ON r.album_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY positive_rate DESC NULLS LAST, review_count DESC, average_rating DESC, a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO album (title, artist, release_year, genre, cover_url) VALUES (#{title}, #{artist}, #{releaseYear}, #{genre}, #{coverUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE album SET title = #{title}, artist = #{artist}, release_year = #{releaseYear}, genre = #{genre}, cover_url = COALESCE(#{coverUrl}, cover_url) WHERE id = #{id}
